Initial release of Free Kling AI Video Generation skill.

- Export finished videos as 1080p MP4 files within 1-3 minutes using cloud GPUs.
- Supports prompt-based video generation, uploads, session management, and video editing actions.
- Includes workflow for checking credits, status, and exporting results.
- Guidance and error handling built-in for a smooth user experience.
